verdict.rationale: The evidence describes a single logo-design skill in the open Agent Skills format, plus a packaging script for that existing skill. It shows no spec, template, or meta-skill that guides an agent to author a new skill. Packaging this skill and following an external format standard are adjacent capabilities, not end-to-end skill authoring.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can author and package a new skill end to end by following the project's own spec, template, or meta-skill
